# udoma_catalog_item (Resource)

Resource represents a catalog item



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_ref` (Number) Account number of the referenced financial account.
- `code` (String) User provided unique identifier for the catalog item.
- `ref_id` (String) ID of the referenced entity.
- `ref_type` (String) Type of referenced entity that this catalog item points to.

### Optional

- `dependencies` (List of String) Codes of catalog items this item depends on.
- `description` (Map of String) Optional localized description of the catalog item.
- `groups` (List of String) Catalog group codes this item belongs to.
- `patches` (Attributes List) Patch definitions that can override attributes of the referenced entity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--patches))
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the catalog item is published and available for use.
- `required_scopes` (List of String) Account scopes required for this item to be available for subscription.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the catalog item.

<a id="nestedatt--patches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patches`

Required:

- `code` (String) Unique code for the patch.
- `format` (String) Patch format (for example JSON patch or unified diff).
- `patch` (String) Patch payload.
